subject: general
question:
What is the computer program that converts source code into object code?

A. Processor

B. Interpreter

C. Compiler

D. Editor
solution:
The correct answer is __**Compiler**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Compiler**, Computer software that **translates** source code written in a **high-level language** into a set of **machine-language **instructions that can be understood by a digital computer’s CPU.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Interpreters** have executed a program sequentially, translating at each step. 
 
• In modern computers, the CPU is contained on an **integrated circuit chip** called a M**icroprocessor**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Analog computers** use continuous physical magnitudes to represent quantitative information.
 
• **Digital computers** represent information in discrete form, generally as sequences of 0s and 1s (binary digits, orbits).
 
• The **CPU provides** the circuits** that implement** the **computer’s instruction** set its machine language. It is composed of an** arithmetic-logic unit (ALU) and control circuits.**
